theme:ai-power.value: 2026-10-20 Korea's LS Electric booked a $138.5 million order from Bloom Energy for 38 kV switchgear and transformers for Bloom fuel cells at a Pennsylvania data center, delivering April to July 2027 (DCD, Oct 2026). DCD says the site is likely Aligned's Project Phoenix campus at Shippingport, where Bloom may deploy up to 2 GW. The same week nuclear names kept falling: Barclays cut NuScale to Underweight and it hit a new 52 week low (24/7 Wall St, Oct 20), with Oklo down about 5%.
theme:ai-power.was: 2026-10-19 NiSource signed a 20 year deal on Oct 16 to supply about 1,100 MW to Microsoft's Indiana data center campus from 2028, with Microsoft paying for the generation and transmission and a 600 MW battery deal alongside. Two days later Microsoft walked away from Nscale's UK site because grid power was not expected until the 2030s. Power is now the gate for AI sites.

theme:robotics-automation.value: 2026-10-13 XPeng set a timeline for its IRON humanoid at its Oct 12 Paris event: mass production by the end of 2026, deliveries in the first half of 2027, starting in stores and malls, and Europe later in 2027. Separately, a Wall Street Journal report says Walmart is still struggling to automate its US warehouses and that Symbotic does not expect a workable in store model until 2028.
theme:robotics-automation.was: 2026-10-12 Two green lights for autonomy. Waymo closed a $5 billion term loan, its first debt, led by Pimco, Blackstone and Sixth Street. And the FMCSA granted a five year exemption (Oct 7, 2026 to Oct 7, 2031) that lets driverless trucks use cab mounted beacons instead of warning triangles, removing the last routine task that needed a person on board.

theme:critical-materials.value: 2026-10-17 China's September rare earth exports rose 6.7% from a year ago to 4,269.8 tonnes, though January to September exports are still down 9.6% (SMM). On Oct 15 China's commerce ministry said it will keep easing rare earth export licenses for the EU and wants the same treatment on dual use cases. US producers fell: MP 3.5% to 40.17 and USAR 5.0% to 10.54 on Oct 16 (dashboard).
theme:critical-materials.was: 2026-10-16 Alcoa reported Q3 on Oct 15: adjusted EPS $1.82, revenue $3.7 billion (down from $3.97 billion in Q2 on lower metal prices), free cash flow $472 million, alumina output up 11% to 2.5 million tons, and the Alumar smelter in Brazil fully restarted. South32 holders approved the AliGroup deal, which Alcoa expects to close in the first half of 2027.

theme:defense-reshoring.value: 2026-10-21 Northrop Grumman reported Q3 on Oct 20: sales $11.1 billion, up 7%, EPS $7.89 against $7.18 expected, a record $109.6 billion backlog on a 1.5x book to bill, and a 2026 EPS guide raised to $29.35 to $29.75 from $28.60 to $29.10. The stock rose 4.57%. Management expects about 35% of the backlog to turn into revenue within 12 months.
theme:defense-reshoring.was: 2026-10-20 RTX reported Q3 sales of $25.0 billion, up 11%, and adjusted EPS of $2.26 against about $1.78 expected; backlog reached $340 billion, $164 billion of it defense, helped by multiyear Tomahawk and AMRAAM missile contracts. It raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guide to $7.65 to $7.75 (company release, Oct 20).

theme:space-quantum-cyber.value: 2026-10-21 SpaceX reported Q3 on Oct 20: revenue $14.6 billion, up 161%, with its AI unit at $7.56 billion, more than half of sales, and net income of $4.4 billion; Q3 capital spending was $19.6 billion and Q4 is guided at $35 to $40 billion. Musk said SpaceX and Tesla boards formed special committees to explore a merger, with no terms and Musk not on either committee. SPCX rose about 4.8% after hours.
theme:space-quantum-cyber.was: 2026-10-17 Cybersecurity stocks broke on Oct 16: OKTA fell 10.2% to 187.26, S 7.7%, PANW 7.6% to 342.00, CRWD 7.0% to 227.39 and ZS 5.9% to 207.38 (dashboard). Bernstein cut Okta, Palo Alto and SentinelOne to Market Perform on valuation after a near 100% rally since early 2026, and reports of AI lab security products (Perplexity, and an OpenAI security acquisition reported Oct 14) added to the selling.

theme:healthcare-medtech.value: 2026-10-21 Intuitive beat on Oct 20 (revenue $3.05 billion, up 22%; adjusted EPS $3.00) but US da Vinci procedures grew only 10% against 20% abroad, it took a $450 million antitrust settlement charge, and it plans extended use instruments, volume pricing and China cuts that lower instrument revenue per procedure 3% to 5% by the end of 2027. It traded near $406 after hours from a 438.00 close. On Oct 21 Abbott matched estimates (adjusted EPS $1.42), cut 2026 comparable sales growth to about 6%, and said it will spin off its $8.5 billion Nutrition business by the end of 2027.
theme:healthcare-medtech.was: 2026-10-17 Viatris said the FDA approved Ryzumvi (phentolamine 0.75% eye drops) for presbyopia on Oct 16, a day before its Oct 17 goal date; Viatris sells it in the US under a license from Opus Genetics, based on the VEGA-2 and VEGA-3 trials. Health care went flat on Friday as energy led, which moved MDT (94.75), DXCM (86.04), PODD (141.10) and ZBH (94.98) to 'Buy zone now'.

theme:ai-compute.value: 2026-10-21 Super Micro said on Oct 20 that September quarter revenue will be $18.5 to $19.5 billion, up from its $14.5 to $15.5 billion guide and above the $15.23 billion consensus, with gross margin of 12.0% to 12.5%; the stock rose about 12.7% after hours. The same day the Wall Street Journal reported Anthropic's draft IPO filing: first half revenue of $16.3 billion, a net loss of $80.7 billion (about $72 billion of it non cash) and compute commitments reported above $600 billion. Demand is still rising, and stock markets are becoming the main funder.
theme:ai-compute.was: 2026-10-20 Applied Digital's CEO and President bought about $6.66 million of stock on Oct 16 at $18.04 to $18.86 (filed Oct 19), after a 22% drop in a week; it is the first insider buying there since May 2023, and its main tenant is CoreWeave. On Oct 19 Goldman upgraded CoreWeave to Buy, calling debt fears overblown, and ARK bought about 132,500 CRWV shares, yet CRWV still closed down 0.44% at $61.12. The rebound faded overnight when Seoul AI data center firm Elice fell about 30% on its Kosdaq debut.

theme:fintech-crypto-rails.value: 2026-10-16 Interactive Brokers reported Q3 on Oct 15: accounts up 35% to 5.58 million, customer equity up 27% to $964.7 billion, margin loans up 36% to $105.2 billion, and the quarterly dividend raised to $0.15 from $0.0875. Separately the SEC approved Cboe binary options tied to company metrics (Chair Atkins, Oct 13), covering more than 100 metrics at 23 companies; Robinhood is expected to offer them first, with no launch date set.
theme:fintech-crypto-rails.was: 2026-10-15 Schwab earned $1.69 a share adjusted (vs $1.66 expected) on about $7.17 billion of revenue, slightly light, with core net new assets up 38% to $190.4 billion and margin loans up 14% in the quarter to $187.9 billion (Oct 15). Bank of America closed Oct 14 down 4.76% at $51.39 after its miss and penalty.

industry:agriculture-food.value: 2026-10-17 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Deere announced next generation perception autonomy kits in early October for tractors and tillage, orchard sprayers, and landscape and construction machines, and AGCO's Oct 6 Tech Day showed PTx retrofit autonomy for mixed fleets. Corteva set its first crop protection only report for Nov 11 after the close. Perfect Day now targets first commercial whey deliveries from India in Q1 2027. No stage moves: these are product launches, not new revenue.

industry:communications.value: 2026-10-16 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Ericsson's Q3 (Oct 15) showed sales of SEK 59.5 billion against 56.2 billion a year ago, 7% organic growth led by Networks, and net income down to about SEK 5.8 billion because last year included a divestment gain. It still sees a flat radio market in 2026 and rising AI driven component costs. The ERIC ADR jumped 11.8% to 10.71 on about 4.5 times normal volume. Amazon had almost 400 Leo satellites up as of Oct 9; AST has not yet dated its next launch.

industry:consumer.value: 2026-10-18 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Dexcom set Q3 results for Oct 29 after the close and Hims for Nov 9; Abbott reports Oct 21. The FDA panel on Sydnexis's SYD-101 myopia drop is still set for Oct 30, and Oura has not set a new IPO date since postponing on Sep 29. No stage moves: these are dates, not new revenue or approvals.

industry:defense-security.value: 2026-10-19 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Drone Dominance Gauntlet II orders have started (Neros 14,000 drones for over $100 million, Swarm Defense 4,000 for at least $25 million), the Army now expects its first LOCUST X3 laser by Q4 FY2027 and combat use by early 2028, and the Senate leader signaled no new Golden Dome reconciliation money before the midterms. No stage moves: orders are small next to the 60,000 drone plan.

industry:energy.value: 2026-10-20 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Behind the meter power keeps adding real orders: LS Electric booked $138.5 million of switchgear for Bloom fuel cells at a Pennsylvania data center, likely Aligned's Project Phoenix where Bloom may supply up to 2 GW (DCD). Fervo's Cape Station is running and it is hosting an investor open house, while JPMorgan cut its target to $27 on Oct 19. Small reactor stocks hit new lows on a Barclays downgrade of NuScale (Oct 20). No stage moves.

industry:financials.value: 2026-10-13 Morgan Stanley moved its target for tokenized stock trading on its alternative trading system to Q1 2027 from the second half of 2026 (said Oct 12 at TOKEN2049), citing market plumbing, products and rules that still need time. It still sees tokenized real world assets reaching $3 to $10 trillion by 2030, against about $39 to $40 billion today.
industry:financials.was: 2026-10-12 Treasury issued its first GENIUS Act rule (an interim final rule reported Sep 30): stablecoin issuers above $10 billion must move to the federal framework within 360 days unless waived, which shuts the state route for Tether and Circle. The OCC says its own final rule is targeted for November.

industry:healthcare.value: 2026-10-21 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Intuitive's Q3 (Oct 20) showed revenue of $3.05 billion, up 22%, and about 14% da Vinci procedure growth, but US procedures grew only 10% against 20% abroad. It plans extended use instruments and other price moves that cut instrument revenue per case 3% to 5% by the end of 2027, and took a $450 million antitrust settlement charge. The stock traded near $406 after hours from 438.00. Gene editing (lonvo-z decision March 10, 2027), AI diagnostics (Medicare fee schedule final rule due early November) and brain implants had no new milestone; no FDA action on CagriSema has been reported.
industry:healthcare.was: 2026-10-11 FDA accepted Intellia's lonvo-z filing with priority review and set a March 10, 2027 decision date, with no advisory panel planned. The first in vivo CRISPR approval now has a date, and chronic HAE drug makers have a clock on them.

industry:industrials.value: 2026-10-13 Symbotic announced on Oct 13 that it is buying cellumation, a Bremen sortation company whose software driven floor replaces fixed conveyors. At the same time a Wall Street Journal report says Walmart's warehouse automation keeps hitting breakdowns and that Symbotic does not expect a workable in store pickup model until 2028, which pushes out the 400 store option.

industry:materials.value: 2026-10-14 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Hexcel confirmed it will report Q3 results on Oct 21 after the close, with the call Oct 22; third party calendars showing Oct 26 or Oct 28 are wrong. MP Materials still guides first commercial magnet shipments to GM for Q4 2026, with no shipment date announced.

industry:space.value: 2026-10-15 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Starship Flight 14 (Sep 28) was the first to reach orbit and deployed all 26 Starlink V3 satellites, though a vacuum engine failed and the stay in orbit was cut short; Flight 15 is penciled for no earlier than Oct 19 but not confirmed. SpaceX was reported Oct 6 to 7 to be seeking about $40 billion of debt to buy Nvidia chips. Planet Labs stock is down about 66% from its May peak even with record revenue, as money rotates to SpaceX and rates rise.

industry:technology.value: 2026-10-12 IonQ agreed to buy Elisity, a zero trust network security company, for up to $1.3 billion in stock (reported Oct 12). It is a revenue and product grab, not a quantum milestone, and it adds dilution.

industry:transportation.value: 2026-10-12 Waymo closed a $5 billion term loan, upsized from about $3 billion and priced at 5.25 points over the benchmark rate, to expand its fleet in the US and abroad. Lenders funding robotaxis is a sign the business is moving from research to fleet operations.

country:argentina.value: 2026-10-17 Pampa Energia director and 10% owner Marcos Mindlin bought about $35.1 million of PAM ADRs at $80.78 on Oct 15 (filed Oct 16), on top of buys by two vice presidents in late September; the insider cluster is about $42.7 million. PAM closed at 81.10 on Oct 16, up 0.8% (dashboard).
country:argentina.was: 2026-10-14 INDEC said September prices rose 1.9% in the month, in line with the 1.9% forecast and up from 1.7% in August. Yearly inflation is 33.4% and prices are up 23.6% in 2026. Housing, water, power and fuel rose most, 3.1%, as subsidies keep falling.

country:brazil.value: 2026-10-21 Polls published Oct 20 mostly lean to Flavio Bolsonaro: Real Time Big Data (Oct 15 to 19, 2,000 voters) has 52% to 48% of valid votes, Gerp 53% to 47%, Alfa 51.5% to 48.5% and Instituto Franca 50.8% to 49.2%, while Data Ranking has Lula 50.4% to 49.6%. The Ibovespa rose 1.57% to 208,295.98 and the real firmed to about 5.02 per dollar.
country:brazil.was: 2026-10-19 AtlasIntel (reported Oct 19) has Flavio Bolsonaro at 49.8% to Lula's 47.6%, or 51.1% to 48.9% of valid votes, down from a 5.4 point lead on Oct 9; Nexus for BTG Pactual has 46.5% to 45.9%. Prediction markets still give Bolsonaro about 77% (Polymarket) to 80% (Kalshi), so polls are tighter than prices.

country:china.value: 2026-10-20 On Oct 16 China made companies register before exporting a list of AI, biotech and solar technologies, effective at once, and proposed banning exports of 12 solar manufacturing methods, including advanced wafer, perovskite and tandem cell know how (pv magazine, Geopolitechs). Finished panels are not covered. Public comment runs to Nov 15.
country:china.was: 2026-10-19 China's Q3 GDP grew 4.5% from a year ago and 1.2% from Q2, above the 4.4% and 1.0% forecasts; growth for the first nine months is 4.6%, inside the 4.5% to 5% target. Factories carried it: September output rose 5.5%, while retail sales rose only about 1.1% and fixed asset investment fell 7.2% for January to September. The statistics bureau said weak domestic demand 'remains prominent', and analysts see less reason for big Q4 stimulus.

country:europe.value: 2026-10-21 France's National Assembly set the revenue vote on the 2027 budget for Nov 3 instead of Oct 20 (TokenPost, Oct 20), so Moody's reviews France's Aa3 negative rating on Oct 23 with no budget passed. The prime minister promised more curfews after the worst unrest in years, and the CAC 40 fell 0.38% to 7,838.49 with French 10 year yields near a 24 year high.
country:europe.was: 2026-10-19 French bonds and stocks fell Oct 19 after a weekend of riots: the 10 year yield rose to about 4.84% to 4.89%, the gap over German bonds reached about 142 to 146 basis points, and the CAC 40 fell about 1% to 1.4% by midday, with Societe Generale and BNP Paribas down more than 2%. Parliament votes on 2027 budget revenues Oct 20 and Moody's reviews France Oct 23. Separately, Trump waived the Graham Act's new Russia tariffs and sanctions on Oct 16, which pushed Brent down about 2% Monday.

country:gulf.value: 2026-10-21 Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Oct 20 that mines stopped three tankers near Hormuz, two of them on fire; CENTCOM called the claims false and said the international waterways are cleared of mines, and no ship names have appeared. Brent touched $111.99 and settled at $108.79, down 0.69%, as Pakistan's army chief took a mediation plan to Tehran. United guided Q4 jet fuel at $4.80 a gallon against $3.90 in Q3.
country:gulf.was: 2026-10-20 The Russia waiver dip did not hold: Brent fell to $106.82 on Oct 19 but settled at $109.55, and traded above $110 early Oct 20 after Houthi claims of strikes on Yanbu and Shaybah (unconfirmed). Energy Secretary Wright said Gulf flows are back to about 80% of prewar levels and the US will let some sanctioned dark fleet tankers carry legal crude; Kpler estimates only about 24 ships qualify.

country:india.value: 2026-10-19 On Oct 16 Trump waived the Graham Act's tariffs of up to 100% on the top five buyers of Russian crude, two days before they took effect. India is one of the largest buyers, so the threat of a new US tariff on top of the 10% Section 301 rate is gone for now, and Brent fell about 2% to $107.60 on Oct 19, which helps an oil importer.
country:india.was: 2026-10-16 India's September consumer prices rose 5.54% from a year ago, up from 4.83% in August, with food up 7.74% (MoSPI, Oct 12). Inflation is now above the RBI's own 5.2% forecast, which backs its Oct 7 hike and keeps another one possible.

country:japan.value: 2026-10-21 The Nikkei fell 1.30% to 64,075.42 on Oct 20 as SoftBank and chip suppliers sold off, then rose 0.85% to 64,621.24 on Oct 21, with Advantest up about 5.3% and Tokyo Electron about 3.0%, after Super Micro and SpaceX results. A 20 year JGB auction drew record demand on Oct 20.
country:japan.was: 2026-10-19 The Nikkei fell 0.6% to 64,916.70 on Oct 19 (AP) as tech stocks caught up with Friday's US chip losses; it had been down more than 2% earlier in the session (Newsquawk).

country:mexico.value: 2026-10-13 The peso rebounded 0.73% to about 18.26 per dollar on Oct 12 after last week's slide to its weakest since November 2025. September inflation rose to 3.45% a year from 3.26%, a bit under the 3.47% forecast. Banxico's next decision is Nov 5 at 6.50%.
country:mexico.was: 2026-10-09 The peso slid to about 18.41 per dollar, its weakest since November 2025, as the carry trade unwound. That hurts dollar earnings of Mexican companies and helps exporters and tourism.

country:south-korea.value: 2026-10-21 The KOSPI closed down 3.73% at 5,552.74 on Oct 20, its lowest close since April 7, then rose 3.29% to 5,735.66 on Oct 21 as foreigners bought a net 660 billion won; Samsung rose 5.67% and SK hynix 5.81%. The won firmed to 1,325.2 per dollar, and chip exports in the first 20 days of October rose 222.5% from a year ago.
country:south-korea.was: 2026-10-20 Seoul sold the AI rebound on Oct 20: the KOSPI was down 2.8% at 5,607.95 early (AFP) and about 3.65% later in the session, below 5,600, with SK hynix and Samsung leading. Elice, an AI data center firm, fell about 30% on its Kosdaq debut despite retail demand over 400 times the shares offered (Seoul Economic Daily, TechNode). Closing levels were not confirmed at writing.

country:taiwan.value: 2026-10-21 The Taiex fell 1.13% on Oct 20, then rose 594.84 points, or 1.28%, to 46,887.77 on Oct 21, led by AI server makers after Super Micro raised its September quarter revenue outlook to $18.5 to $19.5 billion (Focus Taiwan).
country:taiwan.was: 2026-10-19 The Taiex fell 0.6%, or 289 points, to 46,822 on Oct 19 after the Philadelphia chip index dropped 3.8% on Friday; TSMC closed flat at NT$2,420 (Focus Taiwan via Ad-hoc News).
